quarterly_data.signal: Shell completed its acquisition of ARC Resources Ltd. (TSX: ARX), an energy company focused in British Columbia and Alberta, Canada, on September 2, 2026 after receipt of all required shareholder, court and regulatory approvals. Per Shell, the acquisition adds approximately 370 kboe/d immediately across liquids and gas, grows Shell's producing interests in Canada and complements its existing LNG footprint. CEO Wael Sawan welcomed ARC's operational and technical expertise in Canada's Montney basin and said the acquisition increases Shell's exposure to long-duration, low-cost liquids production.
quarterly_data.figure: ARC Resources acquisition completed September 2, 2026; adds approximately 370 kboe/d immediately
